e: I’m not denying that that happened, but one example doesn’t count as evidence.

z: 令人遗憾的是，他并没有在决赛发挥他的最佳水平。
e: The regrettable thing is that he didn't even play at his highest level in the finals.

z: 我们可能会将你的私人信息和其他信息结合在一起。
e: We may combine your personal information with other information.

z: 因为公司的打印机又坏了，我要去便利店打印文件。
e: The printer of my company broke down again, so I'm going to the convenience store to copy documents.

z: 当事情发生在自己身上时，就无法客观冷静地处理。
e: It's hard to stay objective and calm when it happens to you.

z: 我们吃甜点的时候，去那个国家旅游的愿望更强烈了。
e: While eating dessert, our desire to travel to that country grew stronger.

z: 我们公司的技术已经达到了发达国家九十年代的水平。
e: Our company's technology has already reached the level of a developed country in the 1990s.

z: 她作为一个喜欢动手实践的人常常把朋友的汽车修好。
e: As she's a very practical person, she often fixes her friends' cars.

z: 你觉得绕路的司机占所有的出租车司机的百分之多少？
e: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?

z: 建造这堵墙是为了把人隔在外面还是把他们留在里面？
e: Was this wall built to keep people out or to keep them in?

z: 反正到了二十二岁什么都知道了，看书还有什么用呢。
e: Anyway, at the age of 22 one knows everything, so what's the use of reading?

z: “你很丑。”“你妈妈很丑。”“你妈妈的脸很丑。”
e: "You're ugly." "Your mom is ugly." "Your mom's face is ugly."

z: 脸色这么差不要紧吗？要不还是去一趟医院比较好吧？
e: Your face looks pale. Are you OK? Maybe it would be better if you went to the hospital, don't you think?

z: 从2009年开始，超市和便利店就可以出售药品了。
e: Starting from 2009, supermarkets and convenience stores have been allowed to sell medicines.

z: 我希望过几个月后我还能通过正常手段登上这个网站。
e: I hope I can still access this website through normal means in a few months.

z: 演讲者不熟悉他的主题，说得又不好，总之，他很糟糕。
e: The speaker didn't know his subject, nor did he speak well; in short, he was disappointing.

z: 我意识到这个可怕的地下室是唯一可以救我们命的地方。
e: I realized then that this awful cellar was the only place that could save our lives.

z: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
e: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.

z: 这儿周围有没有小菜场跟大型超市，买生活用品方便吗？
e: Are there any markets or supermarkets around here? Is it convenient for daily shopping?

z: 请问，我要用美元换人民币，这儿可以换给我人民币吗？
e: Excuse me, I'd like to exchange US dollars for RMB - can I get RMB here?

z: 如果你不明白一件事，那是因为你没有意识到它的背景。
e: If you don't understand something, it's because you aren't aware of its context.

z: 我们小时候，所有的一切对我们来说都显得那么大。。。
e: When we are small, everything seems so big.

z: 你们可以搜索含有某个词的句子并得到这些句子的翻译。
e: You can search sentences containing a certain word and get translations for these sentences.

z: 将要考虑的另一个重要因素是，目前的情况对我们有利。
e: Another factor to be taken into consideration is that the present situation is favourable to us.

z: 不是坏事，不是丑事，不是错事，确认了这三点就没事。
e: If it isn't a bad, dirty, or wrong thing, then it's alright.

z: 她很漂亮，聪明，并且最重要的是，她有一颗善良的心。
e: She's beautiful, smart, and - most importantly - has a good heart.

z: 专家就是一个能够把所有的错误控制在最小范围内的人。
e: An expert is a person who has made all the mistakes that can be made in a very narrow field.

z: 未来属于我们当中那些仍然愿意弄脏自己双手的少数人。
e: The future belongs to the few among us who are still willing to get their hands dirty.

z: 我是那种面对人群很紧张的人，所以我的演讲能力很差。
e: I'm the type who gets nervous in front of people, so I'm bad at speech making.

z: 越来越多的女人拥有自己的事业并实现和丈夫的经济独立。
e: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.

z: 五成熟牛排见了七成熟牛排为什么不打招呼？两个都不熟。
e: Why didn't the half-cooked steak say hello to the nearly-cooked steak when the two saw each other? They both weren't ready.

z: 这将会是巨大的，如果你可以挑选一些面包，然后再回家。
e: It'd be great if you could pick up some bread before you come home.

z: 我也管理自己的网站，试试记录我的进步而且给别人帮助。
e: I also run my own website, to try and record my progress and to help other people a little bit.

z: 为了按期完成开发，我们请求暂时推迟其他不相关的任务。
e: In order to complete the development on schedule, we request that other unrelated tasks be delayed for the moment.

z: 一开始会有很多不认识的单词和语法形式，但是不要害怕。
e: At first there will be many unrecognized words and grammatical forms, but don't be scared.

z: 因为临时有事，我很抱歉在2月27日那天不能跟您碰面了。
e: I regret that I will be unable to meet you on February 27 owing to an unexpected matter.

z: 在中国，提到过年，许多人想到的都是一家围在一起包饺子。
e: If you mention New Year in China, the image that many people will think of is a family gathered around wrapping dumplings together.

z: 十年来，人们越来越强烈地意识到需要改变自己的饮食习惯。
e: Over the past ten years, people have become increasingly aware that they need to change their eating habits.

z: 因为临时有事，我很抱歉在2月27日那天不能跟你们碰面了。
e: I regret that I will be unable to meet you on February 27 owing to an unexpected matter.

z: 如果你把你抱怨的时间用在练习篮球上，你或许早已不必抱怨。
e: If you used the time you spent complaining practicing your basketball, then maybe you would have stopped complaining a long time ago.

z: 虽然喝多点水对身体有好处，但是一次性喝太多水也是不好的。
e: Drinking lots of water is good for you, sure, but one can't drink that much water at once.

z: 人的后半生就是由他前半生养成的习惯所构成的，其他什么都没有。
e: The second half of a man's life is made up of nothing but the habits he has acquired during the first half.

z: 像灰姑娘这样的故事可以在中国、日本及世界任何国家都可以找到。
e: Stories like Cinderella can be found in China, Japan and in every land of the world.
